comment: Section title in the player-weapon editor: stat modifiers of the weapon's muzzle, optics and underbarrel attachments (HD2Runtime 0.30.0)

en: Each attachment carries its own handling modifiers (sway, recoil, climb, spread, ergonomics). You edit the attachment, not the weapon.
zh: 每个配件自带操控修正（摇摆、后坐、上跳、散布、人体工学）。你修改的是配件本身，而不是武器。
共享配件 · 未经实机测试
comment: Warning panel title above the muzzle, optics and underbarrel attachments

en: An edit changes the attachment on every weapon that can equip it, and the list of those weapons may be incomplete. Whether the game re-applies an edited attachment the next time a weapon is built is not live-tested yet.
zh: 修改会作用于所有可装备该配件的武器，而这些武器的列表可能不完整。游戏在下次构建武器时是否会重新应用修改后的配件，尚未经过实机测试。
